comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Klang v2 (3-knob swept ring mod). build.py reads THIS file. Sweep oscillates the carrier (rate+depth on one knob; 0 = static v1 behavior).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY (fewest stock effects = easy to find).
fxid_comment: 0x01C7. Reverted from 478 to the last known-working id + safe default. (The 478 bump collided with stock effect fxids and broke on hardware; the audible-on-load Mix hack is obsolete now the editor materialises patches via a full-patch send.)

params.name: Freq
params.comment: params[5]. Carrier centre frequency (~0.5..2000 Hz, linear).

params.name: Sweep
params.comment: params[6]. Carrier LFO rate (0..~12 Hz) + depth together; 0 = static.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
